summary: Audited inventory for T1 item 9 (Testbenches shipped): the committed testbench files of 24 sim/ experiments mapped to all 29 spec rows, the cold-start invocation and the pinned PDK revision. Every member file is listed with its sha256 and signoff/check.py re-derives the inventory from the live tree, so the bound hash proves the inventory is current and the member hashes prove the files it describes are. It does not run a simulation or re-derive any measured value.
